entries.text: A waypoint sits right next to Mud Burrow; the bridge onward leads to The Grelwood

Glowing roots. Magical roots with a subtle glow thread through the Grelwood and all lead the same way — toward the Tree of Souls. Separately, follow the river upstream and it always brings you to the Red Vale entrance.

Lit pillar switch. The Forgotten Riches cache sits behind a large sarcophagus near a checkpoint. The hidden switch is on a nearby pillar and lights up as you approach it — that glow is the tell. Pure loot (gold + rare chests, no guaranteed item), and it is repeatable by resetting the zone from the waypoint.

Locust trail. Completing this zone's small ritual encounter spawns a trail of locusts running straight to the Freythorn entrance. Ritual chains always point to the next-closest one — the same trick carries into endgame rituals.

Blood trails + signpost. Crowbells peck at dead livestock and leave blood trails leading directly to the boss — a "farm-to-table" path straight to The Crowbell. A signpost on the road points the way onward to Ogham Farmlands — the Farmlands come first, the Village is the zone after.
Smoke tendrils. The big central altar trails smoke that reaches out toward each of the three small Ritual Altars — follow a tendril and it leads you straight to one. No need to sweep the zone.

Cobble road. Follow the paved cobble road through the village — it runs straight to the smithing house. Stay on the stone rather than cutting between buildings and you land on the Smithing Tools and the Blacksmith's Chest without searching.
